description: List tickets filtered by status, priority, and assignee, ordered by id.

status.description: Optional ticket status to filter by.

priority.description: Optional ticket priority to filter by.

assignee_id.description: Optional assignee user id to filter by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has a 'tickets' list and 'count'; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single ticket by its id.

ticket_id.description: The unique id of the ticket.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has the 'ticket'; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new ticket, optionally with an initial comment.

priority.description: Ticket priority (default 'normal'); must be one of low/normal/high/urgent.

comment_body.description: Optional initial comment body added to the ticket.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has the created 'ticket'; on failure (missing subject or invalid priority), output contains an error message.

description: Update fields of a ticket, optionally adding a comment.

ticket_id.description: The id of the ticket to update.

status.description: Optional new status; must be a valid Zendesk status.

priority.description: Optional new priority; must be a valid priority.

tags.description: Optional new list of tag strings.

comment_body.description: Optional comment body to add with the update.

comment_public.description: Whether the added comment is public (default true).

comment_author_id.description: Optional author id for the added comment.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has the updated 'ticket'; on failure (not found or invalid field), output contains an error message.

description: List comments on a ticket, ordered by creation time.

ticket_id.description: The id of the ticket whose comments are listed.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has a 'comments' list and 'count'; on failure (ticket not found), output contains an error message.

description: Add a comment to a ticket.

ticket_id.description: The id of the ticket to comment on.

author_id.description: Optional author user id; defaults to the ticket assignee.

public.description: Whether the comment is public (default true).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has the created 'comment'; on failure (ticket not found or missing body), output contains an error message.

description: List users, optionally filtered by role.

role.description: Optional role to filter users by (e.g. admin, agent, end-user).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has a 'users' list and 'count'; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single user by its id.

user_id.description: The unique id of the user.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has the 'user'; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.
A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has an 'organizations' list and 'count'; on failure, output contains an error message.
